resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1942 survey description says about 125 feet (38.1 m) for the Loc 1 station tower. The table gives 100 for that tower, and the Loc 2 row repeats it by a repeat mark. The record keeps the survey figure, as the Chita (Loc 1) record does.

notes_for_editor: The 1942 NGS station description (PID BL2168) belongs to the Loc 1 station, not Loc 2; the story uses it only for the tower before the move. The Loc 2 dates (1970 to 1981) and the sale come from the table alone. Loc 2 has its own coordinates only on the lookout list; the 2011 list and the Forest Lookouts Chita page tie the Chita tower to Loc 1. The table prints no units, so the story gives the Loc 1 figure of 100 with no unit. The Loc 2 row carries ditto marks in its manufacturer and height cells (checked on the table page), so it repeats the Loc 1 figure. No staffing, fire, access or current-site sources found. The companion record for Chita (Loc 1) is data/research/us-tx-chita-loc-1.json. No photos added.
